title: Washington Fishing Year
what: Calendar, river map and migration timing for the Seattle fishing year, Oct 2026 to Nov 2027. Dated seasons and rules are artifact-only guidance sourced from WDFW notices; the app never reads them.
note: Edit seasons.json, run scripts/build_fishing_year.py (it writes data.js and fails on bad data), then refresh by PASSING THIS URL with file_path=index.html and files={data.js}. index.html is the built page and holds no data. Omitting the URL mints a second artifact.
